retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: a robbery of the Banco Pinto & Sottomayor at Albufeira on 17 August 1976 by members of the Brigadas Revolucionárias, which took 2,970,000 escudos. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: Assalto ao Banco Pinto e Sottomayor, em Albufeira, em 17 de Agosto de 1976
summary: Wikidata item Q117321949, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "assalto feito por elementos das Brigadas Revolucionárias, tendo rendido 2.970.000$00". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
